avx2_probe.meaning: CPUID+XGETBV at runtime, matching an independent implementation; reported only - no AVX2 kernel, no /arch flag, no SIMD benchmark this round

native_numeric_regression.meaning: bit parity against the scalar oracle, backend reporting and preview/export parity still hold after the lifecycle change

nvof_timing_semantics.meaning: each nvof_* key equals its own QPC span; a span that cannot be timed reads 'unavailable', never 0.0, and no number is reused across stages

per_check_meaning.concurrent_lifecycle_counts: each of N plans created concurrently reports its own create and scratch count, so nothing inherits another plan's number
per_check_meaning.cross_plan_not_blocked: a long call on one plan does not hold up frames on other plans
per_check_meaning.probe_does_not_pollute_per_plan_counters: reading diagnostics moves no counter on the plan probed or on any other

per_plan_counter_semantics.meaning: a plan reports its own lifecycle (1 create, its own scratch and workers) while it serves every frame; process_* stay library-wide

evidence.note: 60-frame A/D only. The 300-frame sustained sweep was explicitly out of scope for this round, so nothing here is a sustained result

quick_performance_regression.meaning: 50% working must be faster than 100%, and both outputs must be the frame count and dimensions they claim

evidence.control_note: residual_bridge.dll built from git 7411d97:native/residual_bridge.cpp with scratch/oldbridge/build_old.bat (the same cl.exe /O2 flags native/build_residual.bat uses), so it is the pre-fix lifecycle code

residual_bridge_thread_safety.meaning: handle lookup, per-plan serialisation, destroy-waits-for-in-flight, thread-local last error and counter isolation all hold under the concurrent scenarios, and the same scenarios fail on the pre-fix build

per_process_source.A: unavailable: nvidia-smi lists this pid but reports its memory as '[N/A]', so no per-process GPU footprint exists on this driver
per_process_source.D: unavailable: nvidia-smi lists this pid but reports its memory as '[N/A]', so no per-process GPU footprint exists on this driver

truthful_gpu_memory_metric_names.meaning: the card's total in use is named for the card; the process figure is asked for separately and reports unavailable with the reason

truthful_pipeline_docs.meaning: the export is documented as a CPU-rendered pipe into an FFmpeg NVENC child, the device-pointer query as diagnostic, and a lifecycle test claims only that its calls returned

vocabulary: DONE_PROVEN only where this round's own run produced evidence; NOT_READY otherwise. The BLOCKED_PROVEN status the previous round used is not available in this round.
